import pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, time, json, statistics, os
root=pathlib.Path('/tmp/stash-review-benchmark')
p=root/'repo'
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=p,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
if not p.exists():
    p.mkdir(parents=True)
    git('init','-q','-b','main')
    for k,v in [('user.name','Mono Dev'),('user.email','mono@example.com'),('gc.auto','0')]:git('config',k,v)
    paths=[]
    for i in range(120000):
        d=p/f'd{i%400:03}'; d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        f=d/f'f{i:06}.txt'; f.write_text(''.join(f'line {j} of {i}\n' for j in range(20))); paths.append(f.relative_to(p))
    git('add','.');git('commit','-qm','base')
    for f in sorted(paths)[:3000]:
        with (p/f).open('a') as out:out.write('stash repeat\n')
    git('stash','push','-qm','repeat')
    (root/'stash').write_bytes(git('rev-parse','refs/stash'))
    git('stash','drop')
    print('fixture ready',flush=True)
if os.environ.get('PREPARE_ONLY'):raise SystemExit()
stash=(root/'stash').read_text().strip()
bins={'main':'/tmp/grit-stash-main-bin','reviewed':'/tmp/grit-stash-reviewed-bin','fixed':'/tmp/grit-stash-fixed-bin','git':'git'}
results=[]; expected=None
for output in ['human','json','markdown']:
    for repeat in range(4):
        for tool in ['git','main','reviewed','fixed']:
            git('reset','--hard','HEAD');git('stash','store','-m','repeat',stash)
            args=['stash','pop']
            if tool!='git' and output!='human': args.append('--'+output)
            report=root/'time.txt'
            start=time.perf_counter()
            cp=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/time','-v','-o',str(report),bins[tool],*args],cwd=p,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
            elapsed=(time.perf_counter()-start)*1000
            assert cp.returncode==0,(tool,cp.stderr)
            raw=report.read_text()
            rss=int(next(l for l in raw.splitlines() if 'Maximum resident set size' in l).split(':')[-1])
            state=[git('diff','--binary'),git('diff','--cached','--binary'),git('ls-files','--stage'),git('stash','list'),git('status','--porcelain=v1','-uno')]
            if expected is None:expected=state
            assert state==expected,(tool,output,'state mismatch')
            row=dict(tool=tool,output=output,repeat=repeat,ms=round(elapsed,3),rss_kib=rss,time_v=raw)
            results.append(row)
            print(tool,output,repeat,round(elapsed,2),rss,flush=True)
    git('fsck','--strict')
(root/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
for output in ['human','json','markdown']:
    for tool in bins:
        rows=[r for r in results if r['tool']==tool and r['output']==output and r['repeat']>0]
        print('SUMMARY',output,tool,'median ms',statistics.median(r['ms'] for r in rows),'max rss KiB',max(r['rss_kib'] for r in rows))
